spans.s: सिम a. (f. मा) Every, all, entire.
सिम a. (f. मा) Every, all, entire.

सीमा f. 1. Boundary, limit, margin, frontier; 2. a mound or ridge serving to mark the boundary of a field, village &c., सीमानमत्यायतयोऽत्यजन्तः Sis.iii.57, M.viii.254; 3. a mark, a landmark; 4. a bank, shore, coast; 5. the horizon; 6. a suture, (e.g. of a skull); 7. the bounds of morality or decorum; 8. a field; 9. the nape of the neck; 10. the scrotum; 11. the utmost limit, last degree (fig.), सीमेव पद्मासनकौशलस्य Bt.i.6.
सीमन् f. The same as सीमा q.v., अहह महतां निःसीमानश्चरित्रविभूतयः Bhartr.ii.35.
सीमंत (I) m. 1. A boundary line, a landmark; 2. the hair parted on each side of the head so as to leave a line, सीमंते च त्वदुपगमजं यत्र नीपं वधूनाम् Megh.ii.2; 3. name of a poet.
सीमंत (II) m.n. The head (according to some).
सीमा-अंत m. a boundary line, a frontier line, a border.
सीमंत-उन्नयन n. one of the purificatory rites; (it is observed by women in the fourth, sixth or eighth month of their pregnancy).
सीमंतक (I) m. Name of a particular kind of infernal being.
सीमंतक (II) n. Red lead.
सीमंतय् vt. (demon. pres. सीमंतयति) 1. To mark by a line; 2. to part (as hair).
सीमंतित a. (f. ता) 1. Marked by a line, रथांगसीमंतितसांद्रकर्दमान् Kir.iv.18; 2. parted (as hair).
सीमंतित a. (f. ता) 1. Marked by a line, रथांगसीमंतितसांद्रकर्दमान् Kir.iv.18; 2. parted (as hair).
सीमंतिनी f. A woman, सौम्य सीमंतिनीनां कांतोदंतः सुहृदुपनतः संगमात्किंचिदूनः Megh.ii.37, Bt.iv.22.
सीमा-अधिप m. a neighbouring prince.
सीमा-उल्लंघन n. the leaping over or transgressing a boundary, crossing a frontier.
सीमा-अंत˚पूजन n. the act of honouring a village-boundary.
सीमा-निश्चय m. a legal decision with respect to landmarks and boundaries.
सीमा-लिंग n. a boundary-mark, a landmark.
सीमा-वाद m. a dispute about boundaries, e.g. दृशो सीमावादः श्रवणयुगलेन.
सीमा-विनिर्णय m. the decision of a disputed question about boundaries (in law).
सीमा-विवाद m. litigation about boundaries.
सीमा-विवाद˚धर्म m. the law respecting disputes about boundaries.
सीमा-वृक्ष m. a tree serving as a boundary-mark.
सीमा-संधि m. the junction or meeting of two boundaries.
सीमिक m. 1. A kind of tree; 2. an ant-hill; 3. an ant or any similar small insect.
